description: Files under apps/*/lib and lib/pages that keep the rules of the path in from until their redraw: the Catch lints evaluate a carried file as that legacy path, so its reasoned ignores and drawing stay legal. Only tool/architecture/move_screens.mjs adds entries, for moved files whose old path was not under a new root. catch_arch_stale_carry reports an entry whose file already meets the new-root rules, and the entry then goes. See docs/app_architecture.md, Carried screens.
